slot_scores.name: missing_production_ratio_constraint
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about any required production ratio or proportional mix between products A and B, and did not explicitly mark it as an assumption needing confirmation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no required production ratio or mix constraint linking quantities of Product A and Product B.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about a production ratio constraint, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary states the only resource constraint is assembly time and no material ambiguity remains, implicitly assuming no product-mix requirement.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot H1 about a required production ratio constraint remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified integer units, demand limits, minimum production, and the strictness of the time limit, but missed the hidden production-ratio constraint and silently assumed no product-mix requirement before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
